_note: Example SysLume node-collector config. Copy to a per-node file, set the node's identity/bind/peers, and point token_file at a 0600 file containing a single Bearer token (e.g. 'cyg-<random>'). Never put the token in this file, in the repo, argv, URLs, or logs. Validated binds are fixed per node: dgx01 127.0.0.1, dgx02 192.168.0.2, dgx03 192.168.2.2. 0.0.0.0, management-LAN and Tailscale binds are rejected.
